classification.difficultyReason: Identify boundary lengths and combine semicircular or quarter-circle arcs with straight edges, including an annulus and an indentation.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of these shapes. Answer to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Rectangle joined to a quarter-circle; printed perimeter scaffold follows beneath.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle dimensions 4 m by 3 m; quarter-circle radius 3 m. Equal-length marks retain both sets.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the permanent scaffold are visible.

spec.description: Square upper section with a quarter-circle below and an internal dashed horizontal radius.
spec.mathematics: All five ticked segments equal 2 cm; boundary has four such straight segments and a quarter-circle of radius 2 cm.

spec.description: Rectangle with a right semicircle and matched horizontal edges.
spec.mathematics: Semicircle diameter 30 cm; both horizontal boundary segments 12 cm.

spec.description: Rectangle with a left semicircle and matched horizontal edges.
spec.mathematics: Semicircle diameter 6 km; both horizontal boundary segments 10 km.

spec.description: Three-quarter-circle boundary completed by two perpendicular straight edges.
spec.mathematics: Radius and each straight boundary segment equal 10 mm; arc angle 270 degrees.

spec.description: Convex semicircular top and concave semicircular lower boundary between equal vertical sides.
spec.mathematics: Each straight side is 10 cm; both semicircles have diameter 8 cm. The lower arc is part of the perimeter.

answer.worked:
Both semicircular arcs form part of the perimeter.
$$\begin{align*}l_{\text{top}}&=\frac12\times\pi\times8=4\pi\text{ cm}\\l_{\text{bottom}}&=4\pi\text{ cm}\\P&=10+10+4\pi+4\pi\\P&\approx45.1\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper semicircle joined to an isosceles triangle; both dimension arrows and centre marker retained.
spec.mathematics: Diameter 6 m; both sloping sides 5 m; triangle height 4 m is retained although unnecessary for the perimeter.

answer.worked:
The dashed diameter is inside the shape.
$$\begin{align*}l&=\frac12\times\pi\times6\\l&=3\pi\text{ m}\\P&=5+5+3\pi\\P&\approx19.4\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded semicircular annulus with equal end segments and an inner-radius dimension bracket.
spec.mathematics: Inner radius 2 m; radial thickness 1.5 m; outer radius 3.5 m.

spec.description: Tall rectangle with a quarter-circle extension below; full left boundary, shorter right boundary, matched radius and right-angle marker retained.
spec.mathematics: Radius 5.25 km, also equal to 15−9.75 km. Straight perimeter lengths are 15 km, 5.25 km and 9.75 km.
